title: Gwajin Rai Mai Dorewa
intro: Rai yana tsaye a lokacin jarabawar Allah, yana neman shiriya da juriya cikin tawali'u. Wanda ya san komai yana juya wannan mai neman, amma daga baya ya bayyana cewa wannan jarabawar zuciya ce. Ta hanyar wannan musayar sirri, darasi game da hikimar Allah yana bayyana a gaban waɗanda suka yi tunani. Za ku iya gane wannan mutum daga labarin Alƙur'ani?
clues: Na nemi ilimi da shiriya daga manzon Allah mai ƙauna
Na zo ina neman gaskiya, ina kiran Annabi da sha'awa ta gaske
An tsawata mini aka kuma juya min baya, domin hikimar Allah tana da wasu tsare-tsare na wannan lokacin.
Duk da haka ban yanke ƙauna ba—maimakon haka, na ci gaba da neman abin da nake nema
Wanda ya san komai ya bayyana cewa wannan jarabawa ce ta zuciya da kuma gargaɗi
Ina cikin waɗanda Alqur'ani ya bayyana game da su: 'Ya yi fushi ya juya baya, domin makaho ya zo masa'

identity.label: Wanene Ni?
options: Munafuki Mai Neman Shakka
Makaho Mai Neman Gaskiya
Mai bautar gumaka na Makkah
Kafirin Da Yake Yi Wa Annabi Izgili
Matafiyi daga Yemen

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Ana tsawatar da Annabi Muhammadu yayin sallah
Ana gwada shi da fari da yunwa a Makka
Ana juya shi a ƙofar aljanna
Mutane sun ƙi mutum saboda imaninsa
Ana gwada shi da dukiya da yara
trial.answer: Ana tsawatar da Annabi Muhammadu yayin sallah

location.label: Babban Sinadari
options: A cikin Ka'aba a lokacin aikin hajji
A gaban Annabi yayin karatu
A saman Dutsen Safa da safe
A kasuwar Makkah da kafirai suka kewaye ta
Kusa da rijiyar Zamzam a lokacin aikin Hajji

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Quraysh ya yi shahada ga mai neman saboda imani
An rubuta lamarin a matsayin gwaji da darasi ga Al'umma
Mai neman ya zama aboki kuma shugaba
An ninka dukiyar mai neman ta ninki goma
Mai neman ya koma rashin yarda
outcome.answer: An rubuta lamarin a matsayin gwaji da darasi ga Al'umma
